mapper.sql: b.id, b.title, b.image_url, b.link_url, b.position, b.sort_no, b.status, b.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(b.status = 1), 0) AS showing, COALESCE(SUM(b.status = 0), 0) AS hidden FROM banner b WHERE b.deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM banner b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1
AND b.position = #{position}
ORDER BY b.position, b.sort_no, b.id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(b.sort_no), 0) FROM banner b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.position = #{position}
